text_block_list.text:
During the camp, Biwa Hayahide and the others ended up
coaching a local kids' race club, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Are you afraid to run?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um... yes, a little...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She's not really like that when running alone, though.
It seems running in a pack makes her shrink back.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's a sad thing when an actor can't enjoy the stage.
If I can, I want to bring a smile to her face.

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Still... lately, it just hasn't been very fun.

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Because I couldn't beat
the fastest girl in our neighborhood anymore..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: When it comes to the fastest... you mean that blonde girl?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you've got your eyes on her!
Her closing burst and racing instincts are truly natural gifts!
Plus, she's beginning to understand how to control the race's flow—

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...!
I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*.
Opera O-kun, please don't intimidate them.
...Winning and losing involves a bit of luck, too."

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Before, we were just about the same speed.
But now, not at all...
So... I guess it just kinda scared me."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(...The feeling of watching someone close to you
bloom with hidden talent... is it?)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Heh... that really hits close to home.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(First, I need to break down the "wall" against her own talent
that has formed inside this girl.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-kun.
Sorry to bother you while you're resting... but will you run with me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No holding back, give it everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To help her sing a flawless aria,
showing her the finest example wouldn't be a bad idea at all...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. I want you to watch
our running very, very closely."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!
Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the fastest running right now...
As I thought, something like this is just...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Did you feel like... "there's no way I can win"?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Still, it's a bit too early to judge.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We weren't like this from the beginning either.
When we were young, we were probably no different from who you are now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for rivals to be strong in the opening chapter!
After all, a protagonist only grows powerful
after fighting through countless battles!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Didn't you ever get scared... of losing?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It won't! Because when it comes to my supreme path...
I believe in it more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter what others think.
Only those who believe in themselves and keep running
can grasp this power.

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe, too...
I want to become able to believe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Then allow me to give you something worthy of belief.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's it! For the distances you girls run,
focus on landing on the front half of your feet!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha!
If you aspire to be a victor, confidence is what matters most!
Come, let me see a smile, and hold your chest high!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Bwa... Bwahahaha!
And in the final mock race held on that day—

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...A dead heat! You did great out there."

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We did it...?
Did we really... tie for first...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Speed born of talent is not absolute.
At least, not to those who believe it can be overturned.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And—all roads lead from this act of 'believing.'
Even to where I and Opera O stand, you see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(The girl believed in her own growth to challenge her talented friend.
Her improvement in training and mock races has been remarkable.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (I believe this is a more important prerequisite than advanced technical theory. This will be the starting point of my growth theory.)
A theory of growth. This was the first step in launching one of Biwa Hayahide's major research endeavors.
